sermon.title: What the Last Days is All About Part 1
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: The messenger came to explain the latter days. Jesus is the Branch who bears the glory, the morning star and scepter from Israel. God is out to improve lives and raise a powerful people, while worldly kingdoms—Greece divided to four, then Rome—rule only for a limited time.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

Because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
